title: Default Values and Omitting Parameters
query: Start a backup of the database
explanation: Only 'database_name' is required. The user said 'the database' (referring to the main one), so we use 'database'. The other parameters (compression, encryption, destination) have DEFAULT values and the user didn't specify preferences, so we OMIT them. They'll automatically use defaults: compression=true, encryption=false, destination='/backups'. Best practice: only include parameters that are required or explicitly mentioned.
learning_points: Default values apply when parameters are omitted
Only include parameters that are required or user specified
Don't add optional parameters 'just because' - let defaults work
